existing_transport_attempt.failure: The first five physical calls failed before an HTTP response; the shared sec_edgar breaker then opened. No call was retried.

official_web_fallback.constraint: Used only after the repository transport was unavailable. Direct official www.sec.gov URLs only; no search, proxy, alternate SEC client, exhibit, or related filing.
official_web_fallback.note: Cached-ref reopens and find operations inspected already-returned pages and are not additional SEC page requests. The web opener reports crawl timing and may serve cached renders.

retained_source_files.reason: The repository transport returned no response bytes. The permitted official web opener exposed normalized page text and line locators, not exact response bytes or headers. No raw-source SHA-256 is claimed.

limitations: Four filing indices and one primary document were inaccessible through the official web opener; those rows or claims remain indeterminate where the index did not independently establish the reason.
Official web line numbers identify the normalized SEC page render, not byte offsets in a retained filing.
No source byte hash can be produced for a page that was rendered but not returned as bytes.
